etymology.historical_story: A romanized spelling can conceal its original script and meaning. Korean naming conventions illustrate why: established personal spellings may remain in use alongside a standardized romanization system. This makes a Korean-name interpretation of kyung possible, but the packet supplies no context to establish that interpretation or a particular etymology. See [NIKL romanization rules](https://m.korean.go.kr/front_eng/roman/roman_01.do).
